name: Study Flashcards
description: Turn your notes, slides, PDFs, or pasted text into source-grounded flashcards and a practice quiz — delivered as a self-contained interactive HTML study app with spaced repetition.
author: Bobby Chang
coverImageAlt: Blank study cards following a luminous spiral from stacked source pages toward a warm recall point
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org skill gallery cover
Primary request: a source-grounded learning cycle shown as a sculptural deck of blank study cards moving through a calm ascending spiral, with several cards returning through the loop and one card arriving at a clear luminous recall point
Scene/backdrop: uncluttered warm-paper study surface transitioning into a deep slate backdrop, with a few abstract stacked source pages anchoring the cycle
Subject: tactile blank cards, a restrained circular memory path rendered only as a smooth continuous ribbon of light, and layered source pages; every card and page face is entirely blank
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; crop-safe focal subject; no essential detail in the outer 8%; strong silhouette and legible at small card size
Lighting/mood: calm, focused, quietly encouraging, with restrained cyan backlighting and a subtle warm orange recall highlight
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, symbols, labels, logos, trademarks, or watermark; no arrows or arrowheads anywhere; the memory path must be a plain continuous unmarked ribbon with no directional glyphs; no paw imagery or paw logo; no cats or cat silhouettes; no product UI or Microsoft Fluent branding; all card and page faces must remain completely blank
